newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) higher.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range today in the absence of fresh market-moving news.
Many state banks stayed on the sidelines on the eve of the issue of China's first seven-year treasury bond, which will start on Friday, they said.
With the central bank promising a cut in bank reserve ratios in the short term, investors were unwilling to build long positions due to market uncertainty, they said.
Traders said the rates were likely to move in a narrow range around current levels in the next few days.
